IDU_file_header

group IDU_FILE_HEADER
struct IDU_file_header

Public Members

uint8_t algorithm

Compression algorithm of input file, This parameter can be a value of IDU Compress Algorithm.

uint8_t feature_1

For RLE: Run length size, value of IDU RLE Run Length. For YUV: Sample type, value of IDU YUV Sample Type.

uint8_t feature_2

For RLE: Run length size, value of IDU RLE Run Length. For YUV: Blur bit, value of IDU Blur Bit.

uint8_t pixel_bytes

Size of pixel, can be 1-4 bytes.

struct IDU_file_header algorithm_type

Compressing information.

uint8_t reserved[3]

Reserved for future use.

uint32_t raw_pic_width

Width of compressed picture in pixel.

uint32_t raw_pic_height

Height of compressed picture in pixel.
